save.title: Add tapmelo for next time
save.intro: Add tapmelo to your home screen or bookmarks so it is easy to find next time. An internet connection is needed to play.
save.prompt: Save tapmelo to find your games again.
save.addTitle: Add to home screen or desktop
save.accepted: Your browser is finishing the installation.
save.cancelled: Installation was cancelled. You can still use the steps below.
save.failed: Your browser could not open the installation window. Use the steps below.
save.ios: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and confirm Add. If that option is missing, open this page in Safari first.
save.android: Open your browser menu (⋮), choose Add to Home screen or Install app, and confirm. Menu names may vary.
save.desktop: In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and look for Install tapmelo or Install this page as an app. On Safari for Mac, use File → Add to Dock when available.
save.generic: Open this game in your system browser, then look in the browser menu for Add to Home screen or an install option.
save.inapp: Open the browser menu and choose Open in browser. You can also copy the game address below and open it in your system browser.
save.bookmarkDesktop: Press {shortcut}, or use the bookmark / favourites option in your browser menu, to save the current page.
save.bookmarkMobile: Open your browser menu and select the star or Add bookmark to save the current page.
save.bookmarkIos: Tap Share, then Add Bookmark or Add to Favourites, to save the current page.
save.bookmarkGeneric: Use the bookmark or favourites option in your browser menu. If you are in an app, open this page in your system browser first.
save.openGame: Open the game page to add it manually
save.copyFallback: Copy this address and open it in your browser:
save.confirmed: I’ve added it. Don’t show this again.
save.confirmedStatus: This browser won’t show this reminder again.
save.progress: Progress is saved in this browser. On iPhone or iPad, a home-screen app may have separate progress.
